rationale: Static ECB explainer page on banknote recycling; a section of the ECB site already covered, no recurring SK statistics of its own.
NBS supervised-entity register portal on its own subdomain — a durable, queryable registry of licensed banking/payment actors.
Standalone crypto-ATM deployer publishing machine locations; a countable non-bank cash-access device layer worth light monitoring.
Second SK crypto-ATM network with a public country map; standalone device-count source, low weight.
Long-running SK consumer-finance portal that recurrently reprints scheme survey figures; monitor the portal, this article is just an entry point.
Trade-press country-survey stream useful for triangulation, but access status unknown (likely partial paywall) — recheck reachability.
Machine-readable daily PSD2 JSON endpoint yielding market entry/exit time series — highest-value standalone feed in the batch.
NBS payment-services supervision hub linking PI/EMI/limited-network lists; the only public view of exempted payment actors.
Master index of all NBS registers — mine once to enumerate registers, then monitor the individual registers themselves.
Standalone creditors register on its own subdomain; entry/exit dating for the non-bank lending/BNPL layer adjacent to cards.
Statutory register of financial intermediaries on its own subdomain; maps the distribution layer for banking products.
MiCA/CASP licensing subsection of nbs.sk; signals arrive via the NBS register index and news monitoring already in place.
Definitive SIPS participant list — identifies who actually clears SK retail payments; updated list page worth tracking directly.
EBA PSD2 register with bulk download and daily NCA updates; the only surface showing inbound passporting into SK.
EBA register index page; mine once for the credit-institutions and other-lists endpoints, then track those endpoints.
Daily-updated ECB MFI list with CSV download — the statistical population frame behind SK banking/payment statistics.
A single dated SSM entity-list PDF; useful evidence for group affiliation, but the list landing page is the monitorable surface.
Statistical business register with NACE codes — enumerates the population of SK payment/financial-service entities; portal-level source.
Public UBO register with a persistent search interface; exposes ownership chains behind SK payment/IT vendors.
Financial-statements register with documented open API and bulk dumps — converts entity lists into revenue/asset time series.
Consolidated open API over ORSR/RPO/RÚZ/CRZ/Obchodný vestník; the practical bulk route into SK company data (verify licence terms).
Official daily gazette — earliest dated signal of incorporations, mergers and insolvencies among SK payment and fintech firms.
Static NBS pointer list naming the SK credit bureaus; mine once for leads to those data holders.
CERI is a continuously updated regulated-disclosure archive routing to bank reports with card/ATM/acquiring volumes.
EU meta-documentation of SK business registers; read once to validate the register map, no ongoing signal.
Third-party mirror of the EBA PSD2 register — redundant with the authoritative source and unusable as citation of record.
